blocks.text: Composites aaj kal ke bohat efficient aur useful (faidemand) materials hain. Composite do ya zyada materials ka combination (milap) hai jis se behtar properties wali cheez banti hai. Aik hissa matrix kehlata hai, aur doosre hisse jo matrix ke andar caged (band) hote hain, reinforcement agents (mazbooti dene wale) kehlate hain. Kuch composites mein aik se zyada reinforcement agent hote hain. Misal fibreglass hai: is mein polymer matrix hai, aur reinforcement fabric (kapre), glass ya carbon wale materials ke fibres (reshe) ho sakte hain. Matrix reinforcement ko pakre rakhta hai, aur reinforcement material ko zyada strength deta hai. Composites ka strength to weight ratio (weight ke muqable strength) achha hai aur yeh corrosion se bohat bachte hain, is liye mushkil (demanding) kaamon ke liye suitable hain. Maslan boat hulls (kashtiyon ka neeche wala dhancha) aur car bodies fibreglass se banti hain, aur carbon fibre light (halka) aur bohat durable hone ki wajah se aircraft aur sports gear (khel ke saaman) ki industry mein bohat use hota hai.
Kitab ki Figure 31.3 tasveer hai: fibreglass deewaron aur chhat ko garmi aur sardi se bachane (insulation) ke liye use hota hai.

blocks.alt: Yellow matrix (maslan polymer) ke andar seedhe blue fibres (reshe) pare hain; leader lines 'matrix (e.g. a polymer)' aur 'reinforcement (fibres)' dikhati hain.
blocks.caption: Composite: matrix aur reinforcement (hamari apni drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Composite mein matrix aur reinforcement ka kya kaam hai?
blocks.explanation: Matrix reinforcement ko apni jagah pakre rakhta hai; reinforcement (jaise glass ya carbon ke fibres) material ko zyada strength deta hai.

items: Fibreglass: boat hulls, car bodies, insulation; carbon fibre: aircraft, sports gear.
